value.rationale: The motivating construction is a distinguished low-complexity Z² Toeplitz system with maximal normalizer. Sharp exact complexity across all dyadic rectangles is a natural invariant not fixed by the published linear upper bound. Its aspect-dependence gives two genuine rectangular Følner sequences with different area-normalized limits and an explicit discrete spectrum of all possible dyadic-Følner subsequential constants. This is structural dynamical information beyond arbitrary small-window enumeration.
